$schema_note: Antigravity v1 schema, proposed 2026-05-22. Item K of 2026-05-21 best-practices synthesis brief. The Anthropic monitors/monitors.json public spec is referenced (Stream 4) but no canonical schema URL was retrievable at write time, so this file proposes a minimal shape and documents the decision inline. If/when the Claude Code 2026 plugin manifest publishes a formal schema, migrate field names without breaking the watch+surface intent.
description: Declarative live-signal surfaces for an Antigravity session. Each monitor watches a file/path and surfaces changes as session events so the operator (and orchestrator) see drift, burn, violations, and fan-out without manually grepping log files. Closes the AI-Memory-Dependent-Observability failure class for the ledger layer.
fires_during: SessionStart, PostToolUse (file writes inside watched paths), session ledger emit

monitors.label: Routing violations (deterministic enforcer)
monitors.purpose: Surface any task that ran with a workflow choice that violated CLAUDE.md mandatory bindings. The most common drift class.

monitors.label: Composite quality score drift
monitors.purpose: Detect grade inflation or regression across recent finalize calls. The 2026-04-24 audit found 94-99% of finalize scores were 8+ (statistically implausible). This monitor surfaces drift in real time so the bimodal taste filter can be re-calibrated before it becomes silent.
monitors.fallback_note: Composite scores currently log to Notion via log_performance.py with no local jsonl mirror. Taste calibration jsonl is the closest local proxy. When chain_runner gains a local mirror at .agent/finalize-log.jsonl, switch the watch path.

monitors.label: Fal wallet burn rate
monitors.purpose: Surface paid-API spend in-session so cost_gate G2 approvals aren't surprising. Fal is the highest-variance spend (poster + video). 1080p Seedance is hard-blocked, but kling and 720p seedance can drain a $20 wallet in 6-7 calls.

monitors.label: Perplexity monthly burn
monitors.purpose: Track Perplexity quota burn. Perplexity is fallback-only as of 2026-04-23 (Gemini Deep Research is primary), but exhaustion still blocks fact-verification at Step 5.5.

monitors.label: Gemini Deep Research prepaid ceiling
monitors.purpose: Surface Gemini Deep Research spend against the $10 prepaid ceiling (3-layer defense: Ultra covers AI Studio, pay-as-you-go OFF, hard $10 ceiling). Primary research tool so burn signal matters.

monitors.label: Sub-agent fan-out count
monitors.purpose: Encode Cognition's anti-multi-agent thesis as observable signal: read-heavy parallel fan-out is OK; write-heavy fan-out is forbidden. Surface count + write-flag per session so violations are visible.
monitors.forward_looking_note: Autopilot session manifests do not yet write to .tmp/autopilot/<session>/manifest.json — Wave 5 currently writes worker-N-slug.md files only. This monitor activates when the manifest emit lands (planned Wave 6). Until then it is dormant.

monitors.label: Recall grounding silent-skip rate
monitors.purpose: Tier 1.5 Recall grounding skips silently on 6 failure modes. Silent skip means a core architectural feature cannot be measured — if Recall degrades, nobody knows. This monitor surfaces the skip rate so the AI-Memory-Dependent-Observability failure class stays closed.

monitors.label: Factual Grounding hard floor vetoes
monitors.purpose: Surface any finalize() call where Dimension 4 (Factual Grounding) scored <6 and blocked delivery. This is the polished-but-wrong failure pattern — the most reputationally expensive class to ship.

surface_routing.session_event: Inline ledger entry at session end (orchestration_ledger.py)
surface_routing.drift_warning: Inline ledger entry + recommendation for re-calibration
surface_routing.constraint_violation: Block at fan-out emit; surface in red in ledger
surface_routing.block: Hard halt in finalize; user must acknowledge before re-run

non_goals: This file does NOT execute monitors — it declares them. A runner (forthcoming) reads this config and tails the watched paths.
This file does NOT replace chain_runner.finalize() enforcement — finalize is the deterministic backstop; monitors are the observability surface on top of it.
This file does NOT include monitors for evolution-pipeline jobs (those live under evolution_store/orchestrator_state.json with their own observability).
